name: iran-default
description: Default candidate mix for Iranian network conditions, V1.5 direct-VPS only. Only families this relay can actually serve. The three opt-in families all sit outside Iran's 53/80/443 egress whitelist — shadowsocks on 8446, anytls on 8447, tuic on 8443/udp — so each buys transport diversity on OTHER networks, not a way through the whitelist. Shadowsocks additionally fails independently of the TLS tiers when a nested-TLS classifier comes for them, which is why it is offered at all.
